payload.summary: codex review round 2 (run rz43bwzm): original 859px finding CLEARED, one new finding on the guard itself. The stacked-breakpoint test asserted the fallback grid AREAS but not its grid-template-columns, and not the player .hand-rule text-align reset — so a regression that left the player's wide minmax(0,1fr) auto auto tracks in place and deleted the text reset passed every assertion. Codex proved it with an in-memory mutation rather than asserting it. Both assertions added; the exact mutation codex ran now fails the suite, as do each of its two halves alone. This is the second time this session that a guard needed a mutation run against it to be trusted — writing the assertion is not the same as proving it fails.
